title: 1992 Upper Deck #134 Barry Bonds Pittsburgh Pirates Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a rare and valuable sports trading card featuring Barry Bonds, player for the Pittsburgh Pirates in the Major League Baseball (MLB). The card is from the 1992 Upper Deck set and has the card number 134. It is a base set card and is perfect for collectors of sports memorabilia. The card is in excellent shape and is a must-have for any fan of baseball.
